en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Husayn Bin Rashid, from Al Husayn Bin Aslam who said,

‘I said to Abu Al-Hassanasws the 2nd, ‘I happen to be in the market, so I recognise the time, and it is straitening upon me if I were to enter (the marketplace) and pray Salāt’. Heasws said: ‘The Satanla approaches the sun during three states – At sunrise, and at midday, and at sunset. So pray Salāt after the midday, for the Satanla intends that he makes you fall upon a limit which would cut you off from the ones besides himla’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from in a marfu‘ manner the following; “Once a man mentioned before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, the Hadith which is narrated from abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, that says, ‘The sun emerges from between the two horns of Satan.’

He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, Iblis has found a throne between the sky and earth. When the sun rises and people prostrate at that time, Iblis then says to his other Satans, ‘Children of Adam perform Salah (prayer) for me.’”
